title: A signed-in caller reaches password change, reset and recovery through the realm's account console
asA: operator signed in through a Keycloak realm who needs to change their password or set up MFA
iWant: the project to send me to the realm's hosted account console for every credential operation
soThat: password material never leaves the identity source and I do not need a second credential-management surface on the project

acceptanceCriteria.description: The discovery client resolves the account console URL for each realm on boot and refuses boot when the URL responds non-2xx to an unauthenticated GET.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a realm-config record whose `accountConsoleUrl` field names a URL that returns 404 to an unauthenticated GET
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot fails with stable-coded `KEYCLOAK_ACCOUNT_CONSOLE_UNREACHABLE` naming the realm slug; the audit sink records one `keycloak.account_console_refused` event carrying the realm slug and the observed HTTP status class

acceptanceCriteria.description: `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl()` returns the resolved account console URL for the caller's realm.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a caller whose verified session names `realmSlug=alpha` and a boot-verified realm-config for `alpha` whose account console URL is `https://kc.example/realms/alpha/account`
acceptanceCriteria.when: a project route calls `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl()` for the caller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the return value is exactly `https://kc.example/realms/alpha/account`; no other URL is returned; the return value carries no query parameters and no fragment appended by the helper

acceptanceCriteria.description: No project route renders a credential-change form of its own.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied blueprint at v1.3.0 and a source-tree scan of the project's contributed pages
acceptanceCriteria.when: a static scan looks for password-input HTML controls (`type=password`) or MFA-enrolment DOM shapes on any project route
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scan reports zero credential-input controls owned by the project; every credential moment resolves to a link out to the realm's account console via `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl()`

acceptanceCriteria.description: An account console URL missing the `/account` path segment or pointing at a different origin than the realm's issuer is refused at boot.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a realm-config record whose `accountConsoleUrl` is `https://other.example/dashboard` (different origin from the discovered issuer)
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot fails with stable-coded `KEYCLOAK_ACCOUNT_CONSOLE_MALFORMED` naming the realm slug and the origin mismatch

acceptanceCriteria.description: A realm without any credential self-service (an entirely federated realm that carries `accountConsoleUrl: null`) is legal at boot; consumers see the capability as absent for that realm.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a realm-config for `beta` whose `accountConsoleUrl` is `null` and whose realm setting disables the account console
acceptanceCriteria.when: the blueprint boots and a caller in `beta` invokes `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl()`
acceptanceCriteria.then: boot succeeds; `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl()` returns `null` for callers in `beta`; the applied capability set for the project reflects `credentialSelfService` as inactive for `beta`
